subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — persist widget state via a setState bridge capability

question: Should dashboard widget write-back require approved SQLite/plugin-KV storage and bridge-level `expectedVersion` before merge, or may this PR keep JSON sidecar storage and the current sandbox bridge behavior as a named exception?
rationale: The PR expands a sandboxed widget's trusted-parent write boundary and creates persistent runtime state, so automation cannot decide the permanent storage/security contract or grant dependency-graph authorization.

options.title: Require storage and bridge repair
options.body: Keep the feature direction but require approved storage, bridge expectedVersion support, dependency clearance, artifact cleanup, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Approve a named exception
options.body: Maintainers and security owners can explicitly accept the JSON sidecar state path and current sandbox write-back model as intentional product/security debt.

options.title: Pause behind the stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the custom-widget foundation branch is clean against main and the write-back delta can be reviewed without cumulative conflicts.

recommendation.title: Require storage and bridge repair
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction but require approved storage, bridge expectedVersion support, dependency clearance, artifact cleanup, and live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main routing signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and adjacent plugin/storage direction involved here.
